🔌 RAG Pipeline — How It Works

1
Index your documents — company wiki, manuals, policies are chunked and stored in a searchable vector database.
2
User asks a question — "What's our refund policy for digital goods?"
3
Semantic search — the system retrieves the most relevant chunks from your document index.
4
Augmented prompt — retrieved text + user question are sent together to the LLM.
5
Grounded answer — LLM answers from the real document, not from memorized patterns. Far fewer hallucinations.
✅ RAG result: "Per our policy (Section 4.2), digital goods are non-refundable unless defective."
vs without RAG: "Digital goods typically aren't refundable..." (may be wrong)
